title: The Overnight Drift
one_line: US equity index futures earn large positive returns around the European open, linked to the previous US close's order imbalance: selloffs are followed by strong overnight reversals, rallies by much smaller ones.

findings.statement: Returns on US equity index futures are large and positive during the opening hours of European markets.
findings.evidence: Abstract: 'pervasive, economically large, and highly statistically significant'. Blog follow-up: the 2-3am ET window earned ~3.7%/yr of a 5.9%/yr close-to-close ES return, 1998-2020.

findings.statement: The overnight return is related to the order imbalance at the previous US close.
The response is asymmetric: market selloffs generate robust positive overnight reversals; reversals after rallies are much more modest.

why.pattern: Execution mechanics / liquidity provision: dealers absorb closing order imbalances and demand compensation for carrying that inventory overnight.
why.mechanism: Sell imbalances at the US close leave dealers long; they offload when European liquidity arrives, earning a premium; the premium is larger after selloffs because risk-bearing capacity is lower then.
why.who_is_forced: End-of-day sellers (closing auctions, rebalancers) who must trade at the close; dealers with limited capacity.
why.why_it_persists: Compensation for risk-bearing, not a free lunch — unless the closing imbalances themselves shrink.
why.what_would_kill_it: Smaller closing imbalances (finer algorithmic slicing) — which the 2026 follow-up says has happened since 2021.

setting.holding_period: overnight hours around the European open

reported_results.headline: 2-3am ET window ≈ 3.7%/yr of ES's 5.9%/yr (1998-2020, from the authors' 2026 blog post).
key_stats: Selloff days → strong overnight reversal; rally days → weak

tradable_edge: Long ES around the European open (02:00-03:00 ET), sized up after a down US session / large closing sell imbalance. Combine with Bondarenko & Muravyev's window; must survive the post-2021 decay.
angles: Condition the overnight long on a down RTH day (proxy for sell imbalance)
Condition on a down last 30 minutes (closer proxy for the closing auction imbalance)
data_fit: ES 1-min (ETH + RTH) Dec 2013 → Sep 2026 in clean_ES_master.parquet; NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026. 2024+ is protected in the backtest project.
caveats: Abstract and the authors' 2026 blog only; the full PDF was not reachable from this session.
